from modelscope.hub.file_download import model_file_download
import os
import time

MODEL_ID = "google/gemma-3-27b-it"
MODEL_DIR = "/root/autodl-tmp/models/gemma-3-27b-it"

missing = [
    "model-00001-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00003-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00006-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00008-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00009-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00010-of-00012.safetensors",
    "model-00011-of-00012.safetensors",
]

for i, shard in enumerate(missing):
    target = os.path.join(MODEL_DIR, shard)
    if os.path.exists(target) and os.path.getsize(target) > 4000000000:
        print(f"SKIP [{i+1}/{len(missing)}] {shard} already exists ({os.path.getsize(target)} bytes)", flush=True)
        continue
    print(f"[{i+1}/{len(missing)}] Downloading {shard} ...", flush=True)
    t0 = time.time()
    try:
        result = model_file_download(
            model_id=MODEL_ID,
            file_path=shard,
            local_dir=MODEL_DIR,
        )
        elapsed = time.time() - t0
        size_gb = os.path.getsize(target) / 1e9 if os.path.exists(target) else 0
        print(f"DONE {shard} ({size_gb:.2f} GB, {elapsed:.0f}s, {size_gb*1000/elapsed:.1f} MB/s)", flush=True)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ERROR {shard}: {e}", flush=True)
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()

print("ALL_SHARDS_DONE", flush=True)
PYEOF
tmux new -d -s gemma_download '/root/miniconda3/bin/python3 /tmp/download_gemma_serial.py 2>&1 | tee /tmp/gemma_download_serial.log'
